[[File:TAG TEAM Pokémon GX Trailer.png|thumb|250px|Frame from the trailer]]
'''With TAG TEAM Pokémon-GX, the Pokémon TCG Will Never Be the Same!''' (Japanese: '''TAG TEAM GX''') is an animated trailer announcing the introduction of {{TCG|TAG TEAM}} {{TCG|Pokémon-GX}}. It revealed the card [[Pikachu & Zekrom-GX (Team Up 33)|Pikachu & Zekrom-GX]] as well. 

It was first shown during the opening ceremony of the [[2018 World Championships]].<ref>[https://press.pokemon.com/en/releases/MEDIA-ALERT-TAG-TEAM-Pokemon--GX-for-the-Pokemon-TCG-Announced-a-82817 Press Release]</ref> The trailer was posted on the Western and Korean Pokémon [[YouTube]] channels and the [[Pokémon Card Channel]] on August 24, 2018, and on the Japanese YouTube channel on November 30, 2018.

==Plot==
The early parts of this video are rendered in  a series of static pencil sketches that are gradually drawn into the frame. The first shot depicts the drawer and their pencil.

A {{p|Pikachu}} in a field with flowers in it notices the [[Legendary Pokémon]] {{p|Zekrom}}. They {{pkmn|battle}} against each other. Afterward, the two become friends and practice their {{TCG|Lightning}}-type attacks together. 

At this point, the trailer incorporates light animation. 

Both Pikachu and Zekrom walk down a tunnel.

The sketches gradually gain color for the remainder of the trailer.

The end of the tunnel reveals a stadium, which Pikachu & Zekrom stride into. The two dive into battle, with Zekrom entering Overdrive Mode. 

The final shot is given increasing amounts of detail. The {{TCG|TAG TEAM}} frame corners float into view, while the TAG TEAM label spins into existence next to the upper-left frame corner. With a flash, both the art and the frame are combined, forming the [[Pikachu & Zekrom-GX (Team Up 33)|Pikachu & Zekrom-GX]] card. Lightning streaks across the background and foreground.

One last bolt of lighting transitions to the "GX TAG TEAM" logo.

The story from this trailer appears to continue in the [[Use the Buddy System in Pokémon TCG: Sun & Moon—Team Up!]] trailer.
